headline: Approved adding or amending 427 voter records and removing 180 voters from the checklist.
summary: Changes came from the state voter database, state vital records and corrections records, town assessor records, and notices from other states. Removed voter records will be kept for seven years.
decisions: Approved adding or amending 427 voter records, with all supervisors voting in favor.
Approved removing 180 voters for death, 30-day notice, registering outside Londonderry, NCOA, or voter ineligibility, with all supervisors voting in favor.
Approved the September 1 minutes, with all supervisors voting in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: Kristin Grages motioned to approve the addition or amendment of 427 voters. John Ambrose seconded. All voted in favor.
Kristin Grages motioned to approve the removal of 180 voters due to death, 30-day notice, registering outside of Londonderry, NCOA or voter ineligibility. Joe Stelmach seconded. All voted in favor.
Kristin Grages motioned to approve the September 1 Minutes. John Ambrose seconded. All voted in favor.
